face_text.instructions: A reference character plate is attached to this shot. Does the prompt ALSO describe the character's face, features, skin tone or hair in words? Text describing a face competes with the plate and loses. 1 = it does describe a face (BAD), 0 = it does not (GOOD).

cinematic_word.instructions: Does the prompt use the word 'cinematic', or lean on film-trailer / VFX vocabulary instead of location-documentary capture language? 1 = yes (BAD), 0 = no (GOOD).

ref_jobs.instructions: Every @ImageN reference must get exactly one job AND a do-not-copy clause (do not copy the white studio background, the split-screen layout, the passport framing or the standing pose). How well does this prompt do that?
criteria: every ref has one job and a do-not-copy clause

cast_block.instructions: The CAST block must name every body that can appear in frame and state that every figure, shoulder, hand or reflection at any frame edge belongs to one of them. An unattributed shoulder makes the model invent a person. How complete is the CAST block?
criteria: names everyone but no edge clause
names everyone and closes the frame edges

ending_state.instructions: Is there an explicit ENDING STATE block describing where people are and how the room looks at the last frame? It is the continuity reference for the next clip in the chain. 1 = present and specific, 0 = missing or vague.

audio_block.instructions: AUDIO must be positive-first, then exclusions. A shot is complete if it does ALL of: states the LANGUAGE of every spoken line; identifies WHO is heard (a named character, or a narrator voice-over explicitly separate from the room); states that everyone else in frame keeps their mouth closed; and only THEN excludes background voices, other rooms, street, TV, radio, crowd and music. A narrator voice-over shot with no on-camera dialogue is fully valid — do not mark it down for having no named on-screen speaker. Excluding other languages is not the same as excluding other voices.
criteria: spoken lines but the language is not stated
language and speaker stated, but no exclusion list
positive-first and the exclusion list is complete

beats.instructions: A 10-second shot should carry three timestamped beats (0-3.5 / 3.5-7 / 7-10). How many distinct beats does this timeline actually describe?

criteria.too_many: four or more — too much for 10 seconds

moderation_risk.instructions: Crun returns 451 on both input and output. Rate the chance this prompt trips it: intimate wording, undress, exposed skin, sexual touching, or violent description. Modest wording and calm motion verbs clear it.
